name: 09-docs-assistant
idea: An internal assistant that answers questions about a company's engineering documentation. It ingests Markdown from a Git repository, chunks and embeds it, retrieves the top passages for a question, and answers with citations to the source file and heading. Every answer must cite at least one retrieved passage; when retrieval is weak it must say so instead of guessing. Documents are re-ingested when the repository changes. Access is restricted to employees, and the ingested content includes private design notes.
